data.background: The TV version broadcast on BS11 and Tokyo MX, while the complete, uncensored version was streamed on AnimeFesta and Oceanveil. This entry reflects the uncut 18+ version of the anime.
data.synopsis:
What if you could actually use a mouse cursor in real life? Takumi, the nerdy outcast, harbors unrequited feelings for his first love, Mone, who treats him with disdain. During computer class, Takumi discovers that his mouse cursor extends beyond the screen and into the physical world...?! With this newfound power visible only to him, Takumi sees an opportunity for mischief. He uses the cursor to get revenge on Mone, clicking on sensitive areas and reveling in her reactions. But when an "Intercourse" button appears unexpectedly, Takumi is thrust into a reality he never imagined possible..."Intercourse"?! Could this really be...?!

(Source: Coolmic)

data.synopsis:
In the near future, the e-sport Dark Machine has become a global phenomenon, reshaping society and even Japan's economy. The only region in Japan designated as a special economic zone for Dark Machine is Golden Valley, a city dominated by its reigning top player Ajima, the seventh person to inherit the title of Senki—the strongest player in the game.

Following his late grandfather's last words, "Find Senki," Kairi travels to Golden Valley. There, he unexpectedly meets Rudra, a girl being hunted by Ajima's group, the Aldabil. Drawn into her troubles, Kairi becomes a Dark Machine player himself. Through one intense battle after another, he begins to develop his own hidden talent.

As Kairi rises through the ranks, he moves closer to facing Senki—and to discovering the truth behind his grandfather's final message. His fight to reach the top of Dark Machine is about to begin.

(Source: MAL News)

data.synopsis:
Twenty years have passed since the combining robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious invaders known as the Aposdoll. With the threat gone, the world has enjoyed a long era of peace. But for toy manufacturer Casga, whose fortunes were built on the popularity of Dandivine merchandise, that peace has come at a cost. Having relied too heavily on the legendary robot's fame, the company has steadily fallen into decline.

Desperate to revive both Dandivine and his struggling business, Casga's president, Genjurou Shijima, dreams of the robot's return—even if it means disrupting the peace. Then, as if in answer to his wish, the Aposdolls suddenly reappear in Tokyo.

As panic spreads among a population that has known nothing but peace for two decades, high school student Gekiha Shijima is recruited by his uncle, Yuusaku Kuroiwa, the former main pilot of Dandivine. Drawn into the cockpit of the legendary machine, Gekiha finds himself at the center of a new battle.

Why have the Aposdolls returned after all these years? And can Dandivine rise once again to face the threat? A new chapter in the fight for humanity is about to begin.

(Source: MAL News)

data.background: Adaptation of Huishuohua de Zhouzi's (会说话的肘子) web novel of the same title.
data.synopsis:
Nuclear winter has arrived, civilization has collapsed, and humanity is no longer the master of the world. Species mutations and scarce resources create an unpredictable future and environment, leading to a series of crises. To protect themselves, humanity has built walls, but outside these walls, survival depends on blood and fire. 

The protagonist, Ren Xiaosu, and his younger brother, Yan Liuyuan, are among them. They were just ordinary teenagers in the wilderness, without shelter or a way out; their only support was each other. But fate granted them the power to awaken in their dire circumstances. The Jingshan earthquake caused the collapse of Wall 113, fully shattering the post-apocalyptic chaos. During their escape, Ren Xiaosu and his family rescue Luo Lan, the military leader, and enter Wall 109. A new life is about to begin, but the real test has only just begun…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
